title: Bridge to Home Round 6 Funding Recommendations
description: As part of its ongoing commitment to address the affordable housing shortage, the City of San Diego is recommending the allocation of $15 million in Bridge to Home funding to support the development of 528 new affordable homes. This funding is part of Round 6 of the gap-financing program, which has already invested nearly $108 million to expedite the construction of 2,148 affordable homes across 24 projects. More information on the recommended developments: https://www.insidesandiego.org/city-recommends-allocating-15-million-toward-528-new-affordable-homes
